description:
The IT Saksham Yuva Scheme was launched by the Government of Haryana on December 1, 2020. 

This scheme aims to provide skill development and employment opportunities to the youth of Haryana.

The primary objective of the IT Saksham Yuva Scheme is to enhance the employability of young individuals through skill training in the Information Technology sector.

The scheme targets youth aged between 15 to 35 years. 

It specifically aims to benefit those who are unemployed and seeking job opportunities in the IT sector.

The scheme has a measurable target of training approximately 50,000 youth in various IT skills over a span of three years.

The training programs under this scheme are designed to cover various aspects of IT, including software development, web development, digital marketing, and data analytics.

Participants in the program will receive a monthly stipend of INR 9,000 during the training period.

The training duration ranges from three to six months depending on the specific course selected.

In addition to the stipend, successful candidates will also receive a certificate upon completion of the training.

The eligibility criteria for the IT Saksham Yuva Scheme include a minimum educational qualification of Class 10.

Candidates must be residents of Haryana to qualify for the scheme.

There is no upper age limit for candidates who belong to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, or other backward classes.

Candidates must also possess a family income of less than INR 3 lakh per annum to be eligible for the scheme.

The application process for the IT Saksham Yuva Scheme involves several steps.

Interested candidates must first visit the official website of the Haryana Skill Development Mission.

They need to register by providing personal details such as name, age, educational qualifications, and contact information.

After registration, candidates must select the desired training program from the list of available courses.

Once the selection is made, candidates will need to upload the required documents which include educational certificates, identity proof, and income certificate.

After submitting the application, candidates will receive a confirmation message regarding their application status.

The training sessions are conducted at various training centers across Haryana.

These centers are affiliated with the Haryana Skill Development Mission.

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Skill Development and Industrial Training, Haryana.

The department has established a network of training partners to facilitate the delivery of the training programs.

The disbursement of the stipend is made on a monthly basis directly to the bank accounts of the trainees.

The first batch of trainees began their training on January 15, 2021.

The scheme is expected to create a significant impact on the employment landscape in Haryana.

By enhancing the skills of the youth, the scheme aims to bridge the gap between education and employment.

The IT Saksham Yuva Scheme also focuses on providing soft skills training to improve the overall employability of candidates.

This includes training in communication skills, resume writing, and interview preparation.

The scheme is part of the larger initiative by the Government of Haryana to promote skill development among the youth.

As of October 2023, the scheme has successfully trained over 25,000 candidates.

The Haryana Skill Development Mission regularly monitors the progress of the scheme.

Feedback from participants is collected to improve the training programs continuously.

The scheme also collaborates with various IT companies to facilitate job placements for the trained candidates.

These collaborations help in ensuring that the skills taught are aligned with the current industry requirements.

The IT Saksham Yuva Scheme is a significant step towards empowering the youth of Haryana.

It aims to reduce the unemployment rate in the state by providing relevant skills and job opportunities.

The scheme also encourages entrepreneurship among the youth by providing them with the necessary skills to start their own ventures.

The Government of Haryana has allocated a budget of INR 100 crore for the implementation of the IT Saksham Yuva Scheme.

This budget is aimed at covering training costs, stipends, and administrative expenses.

The scheme is expected to run until December 2023, with the possibility of extension based on its success.

The IT Saksham Yuva Scheme is a part of the broader Digital India initiative launched by the Government of India.

This initiative aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of digital literacy among the youth.

The IT Saksham Yuva Scheme is a crucial component of Haryana's strategy to develop a skilled workforce.

It aims to create a pool of skilled IT professionals who can contribute to the growth of the IT sector in the state.

The scheme has received positive feedback from participants and industry stakeholders alike.

Many participants have reported successful job placements after completing the training.

The Government of Haryana continues to promote the scheme through various outreach programs.

These programs aim to raise awareness among the youth about the opportunities available under the IT Saksham Yuva Scheme.

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to fostering skill development and employment generation.

It represents a proactive approach to addressing the challenges of youth unemployment in the state.

The IT Saksham Yuva Scheme is a model that other states may look to replicate in their efforts to empower youth through skill development. 

The scheme's focus on the IT sector aligns with the growing demand for skilled professionals in this field.

Overall, the IT Saksham Yuva Scheme is a significant initiative that aims to transform the lives of young individuals in Haryana.
